job.name: s5_greeting
job.prompt: The pharmacist in a white coat behind the counter warmly greets an arriving customer with a genuine smile and a small open-hand welcoming gesture; the customer's tense face softens into a relieved smile. Bright modern pharmacy, soft light. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters or labels at all — shelves hold plain colored boxes without any markings.
job.meaning: Тёплое приветствие — первый сильный сигнал человеку: «Я вас вижу. Я готов помочь», и напряжение спадает
